# Blue Water Travel & Cruises

> Personalized cruises, all-inclusive escapes, European adventures, and destination weddings — planned for you by travel experts with 30+ years of experience. Based in Lake Lotawana, Missouri, serving Kansas City and travelers nationwide.

## Services

- [All-Inclusive Resorts](https://www.bluewatertravelandcruises.com/all-inclusive/): Caribbean and Mexico all-inclusive vacation planning with group rates and upgrade requests handled for you.
- [Ocean Cruises](https://www.bluewatertravelandcruises.com/ocean-cruises/): Alaska, Caribbean, Mediterranean, and worldwide ocean cruise planning with cabin selection guidance.
- [River Cruises](https://www.bluewatertravelandcruises.com/river-cruises/): European and worldwide river cruise itineraries on intimate small ships.
- [Packages & Tours](https://www.bluewatertravelandcruises.com/packages-tours/): European vacations, USA getaways, and custom multi-destination land packages.
- [Weddings & Honeymoons](https://www.bluewatertravelandcruises.com/weddings-honeymoons/): Destination wedding coordination, guest travel, room blocks, and honeymoon planning.
